author: CrashCourse
description:
Geology can’t tell us the future, but it can tell us a whole lot about the past. And when it comes to climate change on Earth, there really is nothing new under the sun. In this episode, we’ll talk about one of Earth’s hottest periods – the Paleo-Eocene Thermal Maximum – and what it can tell us about our hot, hot future. 

Introduction: A Warming Earth 00:00
The Paleocene-Eocene Thermal Maximum 00:40
How do we know about the PETM? 01:52
What can the PETM show us about Earth's future? 05:21
Review and Credits 10:22
